title: Recruiting coordinator daily scratchpad - 2026-03-20
content:
Date: 2026-03-20
Owner: Olivia Chen (Recruiting Coordinator, People Ops)

Top priorities today:
- Confirm final interview panel for Staff SWE (E. Park) - ensure hiring manager (+2 ICs) have correct prep notes and rubric link.
- Clear inbox: follow up with candidates who need next steps (screen -> take-home, take-home -> onsites).
- Block reschedule window 3-4pm for any urgent calendar collisions.

Time blocks / schedule:
- 09:00-09:30: Quick sync w/ Maya (re: 2 upcoming on-sites) - prep slides + interview packs.
- 09:30-11:00: Interview coordination / calendar fixes (bulk invite updates).
- 11:00-12:00: Candidate follow-ups / Greenhouse updates.
- 12:00-12:30: Lunch / buffer.
- 12:30-14:00: Schedule take-homes and tech screen reminders.
- 14:00-15:00: Staff SWE final panel (E. Park) - join 5 min early to ensure Zoom host settings.
- 15:00-16:00: Reschedule block + briefing doc edits.
- 16:00-17:00: Prep tomorrow's candidate bundle + post-interview notes triage.

Inbox actions (quick):
- Sent follow-up to Priya R. (PM) - awaiting her availability for 30-min screen. Action: follow up Tue if no response.
- Candidate: Daniel K. (Data Eng) - take-home submitted, wait for reviewer assignment. Ping hiring manager Lucas to review by Fri.
- Candidate: Sarah T. (SWE) - offered verbally yesterday; waiting on signed offer from legal. Check with HR Ops re: comp doc.
- Candidate: Mateo L. - timezone mismatch for 11am PST interview; offered 4pm PST instead. Resent invite with correct TZ.

Interviews today / details:
- 14:00 PT - Staff SWE (E. Park)
  - Panel: Maya Singh (HM), Lucas Rivera (IC), Priya R. (IC)
  - Interview kit: https://confluence.redwood.com/people-ops/interview-kits/staff-swe (linked in GH notes)
  - Zoom: ensure co-host assigned (Lucas) and recording permissions set.
  - Candidate arrival: ask if they need any accommodations; note vegetarian lunch preference.

Pending / follow-ups:
- Greenhouse: move 6 candidates from 'Phone Screen' -> 'Take Home' after Priya's confirmations.
- Reconcile calendar invites after daylight savings edge-case for Europe candidates (several are GMT+1). Double-check invites for Sofia and Andre.
- Update interview feedback template to include explicit rubric scores (0-4) for clarity. Draft saved: /confluence (see linked_artifacts).

Templates / quick messages:
- Short availability ask (use for initial scheduling):
  "Hi {candidate_name}, thanks for applying to Redwood! Are you available for a 30-min screening this week? I have openings Tue/Wed 9-11am PT and Thu 1-3pm PT. Please let me know a couple of times that work. - Olivia"

- Post-interview thank you:
  "Thanks {candidate_name} - the team enjoyed meeting you. We'll follow up within 3 business days with next steps. If you have any questions in the meantime, feel free to reach out. - Olivia, People Ops"

Notes to self / misc:
- Ask SRE if we can add a 10-min buffer to all interview blocks in GCal to avoid back-to-back overruns.
- Check with Legal about updated contractor NDAs for contractor roles - outstanding since 3/12.
- Create a small cheat sheet for interviewers with red flags + example probing questions (share in #recruiting).

Risks / blockers:
- Hiring manager for Data Eng role (Lucas) might be OOO next week - need backup reviewer for take-homes.
- Candidate timezone confusion caused by Calendly default TZ - consider adding TZ reminder in scheduling message.

End-of-day wrap-up checklist:
- Update Greenhouse statuses (done / pending list).
- Send summary + next steps to hiring teams for interviews that happened today.
- Move finished candidates to appropriate next-stage folders and attach feedback.
- Quick note in #people-ops about any urgent reschedules so ops can adjust desks/rooms.

Quick scratch notes (incomplete/thoughts):
- Look into whether we can integrate Zoom alternative link for EU hosts (company policy?).
- Candidate survey post-interview - draft short 3-question form.

---
Last updated: 2026-03-20 08:55 PT
